findings.finding: Restricted continuum Hessians and finite fits treated as full stability, physical formation and mandatory clock normalization.

findings.finding: Two walls and three sample spectra promoted to universal zero modes, tension and domain formation.

findings.finding: Excluded update clause still described as axiomatic; stationary magnetization and covariance bounds promoted to temporal memory, exact potential shape and universal reversibility.

findings.finding: Finite symbolic and simulation evidence omitted beta-zero, aliased stencils, denominator and stationary-state qualifications; source-response runner used implicit floating division.
findings.resolution: Restore beta-zero/alias exceptions, L>=4, positive denominator or undivided inequality and sphere scope; retain symbolic sufficient bounds rather than unbounded quadrature decimals; exactify integer divisions in source-response covariance enumeration; historical simulations and state-selection limits deferred.
